dedupe_keys.name: augmented smart home with weather information

description: Marcos Rodríguez Vega and Lamine Syne publish an augmented smart-home dataset for modelling multiple household devices. The source identifies a one-minute household smart-meter and regional-weather dataset by Taranvee as the starting resource. It adds columns for car charging, water heating, air conditioning, home theatre, outdoor lighting, microwave, laundry and pool pumping. The native metadata explicitly links these added columns to modelling multi-device scenarios within one home. Their generation method and whether they represent measurements or synthetic values are not established by the repository description. The listed unit is kW, although the source calls it energy usage; kW measures power. One public CSV file of 207,489,749 bytes is listed. Version 1 was published in February 2025 and the repository declares CC0 1.0 without a stated charge. The underlying Kaggle resource has separate terms that were not inspected. Geographic location, observation dates and update frequency remain unstated. This is a derived dataset with added variables, not an asserted copy of the original. No directly related catalogue record was confirmed.
